Dear Bill,

With reference to my last email, just as a follow-up, IPI is now organizing our conference on a global defence
system related to future pandemics. The idea springs out of your thinking on this matter, which has already
found broad resonance — as for instance voiced by Chancellor Angela Merkel recently. Confirmed speakers are
Margaret Chan, Peter Maurer, and Michael Moller (head of the UN Office in Geneva). Jim Kim will also be
sending a senior person to attend.

I do believe that the threat of future pandemics will be one of the most serious future challenges to the
multilateral system and to mankind. I think for you to give the keynote address at the opening of our
conference would be profoundly instrumental to move the necessary measure forward, and I do hope that your
calendar will allow you to be present.

The conference will be strictly policy oriented, towards a reform of the current system and to setting up
possible new mechanism for resilience and the management of future crises. The conference will be held on
September 11-12, and your presence would only be required for about 2 hours in the Palais de Nations in
Geneva on September 12th.

The event is fully financed and will not require further financial assistance.

EFTA00854560

 I hope your foundation is happy with the cooperation with IPI so far. We were very pleased with the recent
meetings that took place in Seattle with the team, and in New York and Geneva with Christopher Elias. And I
am looking forward to future cooperation in multiple fields.

If you would have the time, I think it would be useful if we could meet in the near future. I will be in Europe
for the next two weeks, and could meet you on short notice.

Warmest,
Terje
